title: SEBI eases SGF rules for commodity derivatives clearing houses
theme: SEBI eases SGF rules for commodity derivatives clearing houses
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: SEBI eases SGF rules for commodity derivatives clearing houses
constituentArticles.text: SEBI proposed reducing Z-score for historical stress testing in commodity derivatives from 10 to 5, revising Core Settlement Guarantee Fund coverage to top 3 defaults.

keyFacts: SEBI proposed reducing Z-score for historical stress testing in commodity derivatives from 10 to 5, revising Core Settlement Guarantee Fund coverage to top 3 defaults.
